## Approved Scope Boundary

Option B (Skool-inspired MVP) is approved as the Lead Lab product boundary. It includes the original portal capabilities plus community, classroom, calendar, roles, and moderation features. Payments, discovery, gamification, direct messaging, multiple communities, native apps, advanced analytics, and migration remain excluded.
